annotations.title: Get the Moon's phase and the lunation's exact times

description:
Returns the Moon's phase at an instant: phase angle, illuminated fraction, the eight-fold name, waxing or waning, age in days, tropical sign and degree, distance, and the four principal phases of that lunation to the second in UTC; optionally every principal phase across a date range.

DELEGATE THIS RATHER THAN DERIVING IT: days since a remembered new moon divided by 29.53 uses the MEAN month, and a real new moon can fall over half a day from it, worst at the quarter or full moon somebody puts in a calendar. Phase names follow Moon-Sun elongation. Phase changes within a day: send the user's hour as UTC (the default is 00:00).

CITATION: required. See server instructions.

date.description: The date, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, 1700-2200. Example: "2026-09-20". Omit: today (UTC).

time.description: Time of day HH:MM in UTC, not local and not a birth time. Example: "12:00". Omit for 00:00 UTC.

to.description: End of a range, ISO YYYY-MM-DD, up to 400 days after date. Example: "2026-12-31". Lists every principal phase between.

name: compute_moon_phase
title: Get the Moon's phase and the lunation's exact times
